notes: Custom Meta license, not OSI-approved. Commercial use is allowed but products with >700M monthly active users need a separate license from Meta, and attribution ('Built with Llama') is required. Gated repo requiring HF access approval. Self-verify current terms before commercial use.

name: Phi-3.5-mini-instruct
notes: MIT, ungated (no HF access request needed unlike Llama). Default model for 02_STORY_ENGINE/agents/base.py's LocalTransformersProvider -- runs fully offline once weights are cached, no API key. Small (3.8B params), so weaker at long-context structured JSON output than the 7-8B options above; increase max_retries in BaseAgent if validation failures are frequent.
